description: Execute a predeclared direct-vs-bridged KLT diagnostic on six existing DEV clips. No TEST media, oracle, hyperparameter selection or GPU work.
source_of_truth: GitHub main frozen clean checkout SHA. Outputs, frames, videos and private answers remain only on Tang.
failure_policy: One attempt per stage, stop on failure, retain state/logs/output, repair only with new GitHub SHA and new tested directory.
test_policy: DEV-only diagnostic: independent already-scored Batch46 TEST is prohibited for any threshold tuning. Spatial cross-fit and paired support are diagnostic, not target ground truth.
gpu_policy: CPU-only stages; do not compete with GPU and keep global experiment lock semantics unchanged.
data_policy: Read only SHA-pinned official Kinetics Batch46 DEV archive members; do not read TEST media, oracles, weights, secrets.
